summary: Iter60 backend testing of NEW Refund Approval Chain (/api/refunds/*). All 18 tests PASSED (100%). Coverage: (1) Reasons CRUD - default seeds present (weather/engine/night etc.), admin add+delete work, customer 403; (2) Customer-cancel with departure ~30d out correctly applies 10% policy deduction (paid=100000 -> refundable=90000), booking flips to cancellation_requested, duplicate cancel -> 400, non-owner -> 403; (3) Operator-cancel WITHOUT valid reason_id -> 400, WITH valid reason -> full refund (0% deduction) and booking gets operator_cancel_reason; (4) 2-of-5 approval with EMAIL OTP - sales request-otp works, wrong OTP -> 401, sales first approval -> 1/2 pending, sales double-approve blocked (400 already approved), admin second approval -> approved status, booking cancelled, refund_amount set, refund_transactions row created with method=pending_gateway; (5) Admin-only gate - after inserting invoice_email_log status=sent, sales request-otp -> 403 'only Admin/CEO', admin request-otp -> 200; (6) Manual partial refund by admin -> created; amount > paid -> 400; (7) GET /api/refunds/pending - staff 200, customer 403. All refund_otps read directly from mongo db.refund_otps as instructed.

minor.issue: IMPORTANT CONFIG NOTE (not a code bug): The seeded sales user (sales@airyatra.co.in) has roles=['sales','admin'] in mongo. Because _role_of() picks the highest role in order (ceo>super_admin>admin>...>sales), a sales-login effectively behaves as 'admin' and bypasses the admin-only invoice gate. Tests worked around this by temporarily stripping 'admin'/'super_admin'/'ceo' from the sales user's roles during the module run and restoring them in teardown. If sales@ should be sales-only in production the extra 'admin' role must be removed from the seed; if the dual-role is intentional, then the admin-only gate cannot be verified using this account and a pure-sales test user should be seeded.

OTP is not invalidated on wrong-code attempts — same code remains usable after any number of 401s until it expires or is consumed. Minor security hardening opportunity (add attempt counter / 3-strike lock).

Any staff role (sales/accounts/finance/admin/CEO) can create a manual refund request via _role_of() check. Spec does not explicitly restrict this, but consider whether junior roles should be gated to admin-only for manual creation.

action_items: Decide whether sales@airyatra.co.in should retain the 'admin' role (currently ['sales','admin']). If sales-only, remove 'admin' from seed to make the invoice-sent admin-only gate actually enforceable via that account.
Optional: invalidate refund OTP after N (e.g. 3) failed attempts.
critical_code_review_comments: refund_approval_routes.py _role_of() returns FIRST matched role in priority order; combined with sales user having ['sales','admin'] this bypasses the SENIOR_ROLES gate. The gate logic itself is correct (checks role in SENIOR_ROLES) but is only as strong as the seeded role assignments.

OTP verification (L264-266) compares expires_at string with _now().isoformat() lexicographically — works because both are UTC ISO with same offset, but a subtle timezone/format drift would silently pass expired OTPs. Consider parsing to datetime for comparison.

_policy_deduction_pct assumes IST offset (+05:30) hardcoded for parsing departure_date; if departure_date is already ISO with timezone, parsing may misinterpret. Currently fine for test data but worth defensive parsing.

Sales user roles temporarily changed (['sales','admin'] -> ['sales']) during run and restored to ['sales','admin'] in teardown.
